parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: TargetMajorVersion
parameters.description: The target instance major engine version. The value must be greater than the current instance version.

parameters.name: UpgradeMode
parameters.description:
The upgrade mode. Valid values:

- **zeroDownTimeUpgrade**: zero-downtime migration.
- **inPlaceUpgrade**: in-place deployment.
- **greenBlueDeployment**: blue-green deployment.
